name: Drawing Status Report
summary: Lists every drawing on the layouts with its Drawing Manager status, source and path, exports the list and updates the drawings you choose.

versions.changelog: With Tapir 2.0.2 or later it reads every drawing in one pass, without opening each layout, so a project with many layouts is read much faster. Older Tapir versions still open the layouts one by one.
First version in the marketplace, the same as the built-in script of the same name.
